## 🤖 AI Involvement

<!-- [REQUIRED] Check the highest level that applies to any meaningful part of this PR. The levels are defined in the AI Policy (AI_POLICY.md). -->

- [ ] **Level 0 (Human-authored):** No generative AI was used.
- [ ] **Level 1 (AI-supported):** AI was only used for questions, explanations, reviews, trivial completions, or grammar.
- [ ] **Level 2 (AI-assisted):** AI generated parts of this PR. I edited them and understand every line.
- [ ] **Level 3 (Human-in-the-loop):** AI generated most of this PR under my step-by-step direction. I reviewed and tested all of it.
- [ ] **Level 4 (Agent-driven):** An AI agent produced this PR on its own. The human sponsor reviewed it before requesting review.
- [ ] **Level 5 (Fully automated):** A registered automation produced this PR (see the Automation Register in AI_POLICY.md).

<!-- [REQUIRED for Level 2 and above] Complete the details below. Remove them for Levels 0-1. -->

- **Tools / agents:** <!-- e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex. Include the model if known. -->
- **How AI was used:** <!-- e.g., "Generated the unit tests; I wrote the implementation." -->
- **How the output was verified:** <!-- e.g., "Ran the test suite, checked every link, and reviewed each line." -->
- **Human sponsor:** <!-- [Level 4-5] @username of the person accountable for this PR. -->
